body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). `packages/backlog-groom/test/apply-e2e.test.mjs` and `packages/backlog-groom/test/cli-e2e.test.mjs` manage temporary test fixtures via a global `SANDBOXES` array, `registerSandbox` helper, and file-level `after(() => ...)` hook, and are allowlisted in `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`. With `@adlc/core/test-kit` (`tmp`), each test creates its sandboxes bound to the test context `t`, automatically cleaning them up via `t.after` when the individual test finishes.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `packages/backlog-groom/test/apply-e2e.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update `sandbox(t, { reviewExit = 0, profile = null, ghFails = false, issueLabels = ['bug'] } = {})` to accept `t` as first argument.
   - Allocate `dir = tmp(t, 'groom-apply-')` and `tmpDir = tmp(t, 'groom-apply-tmp-')`.
   - Delete the file-level `const SANDBOXES = [];`, `registerSandbox`, and file-level `after(() => ...)` block.
   - Update all test declarations to accept `t` parameter from `test(...)` and pass `t` to `sandbox(t, ...)`.
2. In `packages/backlog-groom/test/cli-e2e.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update `sandbox(t, issues = [])` to accept `t` as first argument.
   - Allocate `dir = tmp(t, 'groom-e2e-')`.
   - Delete the file-level `const SANDBOXES = [];`, `registerSandbox`, and file-level `after(() => ...)` block.
   - Update all test declarations to accept `t` parameter from `test(...)` and pass `t` to `sandbox(t, ...)`.
3. In `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`:
   - Remove `'packages/backlog-groom/test/apply-e2e.test.mjs'` and `'packages/backlog-groom/test/cli-e2e.test.mjs'` from the `ALLOWLIST` set.
4. Verification:
   - `npm test -w packages/backlog-groom` exits 0 with all 483 tests passing.
   - `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` exits 0.
   - `grep -c 'registerSandbox' packages/backlog-groom/test/apply-e2e.test.mjs packages/backlog-groom/test/cli-e2e.test.mjs` outputs 0, 0.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `grep -c 'registerSandbox' packages/backlog-groom/test/apply-e2e.test.mjs packages/backlog-groom/test/cli-e2e.test.mjs` reports 0, 0.
- AC2 `grep -c 'SANDBOXES' packages/backlog-groom/test/apply-e2e.test.mjs packages/backlog-groom/test/cli-e2e.test.mjs` reports 0, 0.
- AC3 `grep -E 'packages/backlog-groom/test/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` returns nothing.
- AC4 `npm test -w packages/backlog-groom` exits 0 with all tests passing.
- AC5 `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` exits 0.
- AC6 `adlc rails-guard` exits 0.
title: refactor(backlog-groom): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate SANDBOXES fixture leaks in apply-e2e and cli-e2e tests
